output.narrative:
Revenue increased by 252.7 (22.11%), driven primarily by requests (contribution: 220.17) and ecpm (contribution: 36.81). 

Focusing on the ecpm metric, ad_format=video was identified as the primary driver, with an explanatory power of 1.352 and a high lift of 10.37. Within video, the movement was further concentrated in category=finance, backed by an explanatory power of 0.714 and a lift of 9.76. 

By contrast, ad_format=banner was checked and ruled out as a primary driver, showing a negative explanatory power of -1.138 and a lift of -3.27.
